messages:
Liam H: quick sync 1Nebula ops pinged about launching in eu-southwest-2. they want a marketplace SKU and a soft quota for launch — asking for 40 GPU slots initially, ability to scale to 120 after week 2 if metrics look good. theyre pushing a joint announcement in ~6 weeks.
Maya P: ok. legal + finance need to sign off before listing. ill pull contracts and ask for the exhibit template. timeline tight but doable if we move fast.
Jess K: clarifying: are we reserving Dedicated capacity or creating a marketplace entitlement (payg) with partner-backed commitment?
Liam H: marketplace entitlement (payg) but Nebula will underwrite the first-month commit so customers get immediate availability.
Ana R: networking/KMS note: Nebula prefers customer VPC peering + their KMS tenancy. we need to validate cross-account key policies and peering CIDR ranges.
Yi C: sales intel: a few EMEA customers (Madrid, Lisbon) specifically asked for low-latency in that region. Nebula already has a local edge partnership so this should be fast to validate.
Maya P: is a temporary SLA carveout required for the launch? legal might want an addendum for initial launch window.
Jess K: ops checklist draft: 
```
- allocate 40 A100-equivalent vGPUs in eu-southwest-2 (reserve for 72h)
- create marketplace SKU + entitlement mapping
- draft cross-account KMS policy
- validate VPC peering + egress routes
- create observability dashboard (p50/p90 latency, token costs)
- schedule perf window post-peering
```
Liam H: Ana can you draft the KMS policy + a short peering runbook? link to templates: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-onboard
Ana R: will do. aim to post a PR with a snippet by EOD.
Yi C: target customers for beta: Acme EU, Fathom Health, Snapline. ill hold outreach until quotas confirmed.
Maya P: finance question: who invoices the partner commit first month? partner pays or we invoice Nebula?
Liam H: partner pays initial commit, then CSP marketplace billing flows as usual. ops will share estimated unit economics for margin review.
Jess K: tagging infra: @deploy-bot can you open a quota request for 40 -> 120 scale and link here?
deploy-bot: Ticket created: Q-2026-1127. ETA for allocation: 48 hours. Link: https://infra.tickets/Q-2026-1127
Ana R: KMS policy draft (snippet):
```
resource "kms_key" "nebula_shared" {
  description = "nebula marketplace integration - restricted"
  policy = <<POLICY
  { "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::NEBULA:role/marketplace" }, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"] } ] }
  POLICY
}
```
Liam H: perf targets for launch: p50 embeddings < 60ms, p90 generation < 200ms. Jess, can we validate once peering is up?
Jess K: yes. schedule a short perf window next week. well run ping, small-gen (256 tokens) and embeddings sample.
Liam H: action owners: Ana - KMS + runbook (EOD). Jess - reserve GPUs & perf window (48h). Maya - loop legal/finance (2 business days). Yi - customer invites after quota confirmed. deploy-bot - ticket Q-2026-1127.
Maya P: noted; adding contracts to thread and requesting the exhibit template now.
Ana R: PR created: https://git.internal/repos/nebula-integration/pulls/12 (KMS + runbook).
Liam H: tentative announcement target: 2024-12-15. flag blockers here. :rocket:
